message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration serves as a magazine cover for "TEMPO 50 Tahun!". The top third features gray and white text on a black background, including "INVESTIGASI" and the large title "BEREBUT KOMODO". A block of white Indonesian text sits above a central rectangular window or display case.

The illustration depicts several people in heavy winter coats and hats, viewed from behind or the side, standing on a dark foreground. On the far left, a man in a black coat and hat wears a black face mask and holds a striped bag. To his right, people in red, white, and dark blue coats look toward a brightly lit central scene. 

Inside a rectangular frame resembling a window display or diorama, a single brown komodo dragon stands on light-colored ground. Behind it is a wooden gate labeled "KOMODO PARK". Further back, a skyline of tan, rectangular buildings rises under a pale yellow sky. Small red and blue flags fly from red-and-white striped tents. A white cat sleeps curled up on the dark ground in the lower center. A barcode and QR code are in the bottom right corner.
